note: The named-verdict gate (docs/editorial/named-institutions.md, D-028). A Receipt whose verdict names a company, institution or person is counted here once it is published with the founder's approval. The founder's one-tap approval stays until `target` such Receipts have run with no correction. Corrections are counted from lib/corrections.ts (a correction whose pieceHref is /receipts/<slug>). `replies` is the right-of-reply log (rule 3): one entry per right of reply sent. Append only: never delete or rewrite an entry; add a new one that says what it corrects. No email addresses and no names of people here (public repository).
